notes: Fill from Sitefire trial Analyze results. Replace demo rows with status sitefire. slug must match signals.slug (keyword lowercased, spaces -> -).

schema.status: demo | sitefire — demo rows are placeholders, never cite them as findings
schema.cited: string[] of domains/brands the AI named
schema.localCited: true if any country-specific tool was named
schema.citationShape: none | fragmented | dominated — none and fragmented mean opposite things, see ai-citation-gap.ts
schema.answerType: product | directory | advice | hardware — what the AI answers with when it has no product
schema.engines: string[] of engines the prompt ran on
schema.engineDisagreement: true if engines named different winners (or one named none) — unstable answer = opening
